name: perdev
description: A local-first AI coding agent that runs on your own model.

perdev.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL used for chat and the agent. Point it at any server that speaks /chat/completions.

perdev.apiKey.description: API key sent as a Bearer token. Ollama ignores it.

perdev.chatModel.description: Model used for chat and the agent.

perdev.autocomplete.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama server used for fill-in-the-middle autocomplete (native /api/generate).

perdev.autocomplete.model.description: Base (non-instruct) model used for fill-in-the-middle autocomplete.

perdev.autocomplete.debounceMs.description: Delay after typing before asking for a completion.

perdev.agent.maxSteps.description: Maximum tool-call rounds per request before the agent stops.

perdev.agent.maxContextChars.description: Approximate conversation size (characters) before old tool output is trimmed. Keep it under the model's context window (~3.5 chars per token).

perdev.agent.approveEdits.description: Ask before writing or editing files.

perdev.dataDir.description: Folder where sessions and autocomplete feedback are logged as JSONL training data. Empty uses the extension's global storage folder.

perdev.logTrainingData.description: Log agent sessions and accepted completions for fine-tuning later. Data never leaves your machine.
